title: GUI Toggles & State-Driven UI
summary: Show/hide UI by flipping ONE source of truth (Visible or Enabled), not by remembering scattered changes. Button activates → state flips → UI reflects state. Optional tweens for polish.

verification.source: Community-established pattern; consistent with Roblox GUI documentation

explanation.whatItIs: State-driven UI discipline: a boolean (or enum) owns the truth; every visual derives from it.
explanation.whyItExists: Ad-hoc show/hide code rots fast — menus open twice, buttons vanish, states desync. One flag, one render path.
whenToUse: Toggle keybind (E/Tab) + button, both funneling into the same flip
Add a tween between states for feel (see tweening)
whenNotToUse: One-shot notifications — just show, wait, hide
Server-controlled UI state you can't mirror locally without remotes (then sync via events)
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
state.open = false

function render()
    panel.Visible = state.open        ← only place UI reacts
end

function toggle()
    state.open = not state.open
    render()
end

Button.Activated → toggle()
Keybind(E)       → toggle()
```
tips: ScreenGui.Enabled hides EVERYTHING under it — cheapest global toggle
Frame.Visible for subtrees; both work, pick a convention
Tween in/out but keep state instant — visuals catch up
commonMistakes: Two buttons each setting Visible directly — states diverge
Forgetting to reset UI on respawn (ResetOnSpawn interplay)
Input passthrough: open menus should often capture/block game input

examples.title: Toggle with tween and keybind
examples.code:
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local screen = script.Parent
local panel = screen.ShopPanel
local button = screen.ToggleButton

local open = false
local info = TweenInfo.new(0.25, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

local function render()
    local goal = { BackgroundTransparency = open and 0 or 1 }
    TweenService:Create(panel, info, goal):Play()
    for _, child in panel:GetDescendants() do
        if child:IsA("GuiObject") then
            child.Visible = open or child.BackgroundTransparency < 1
        end
    end
end

local function toggle()
    open = not open
    render()
end

button.Activated:Connect(toggle)
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, processed)
    if processed then return end
    if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.B then toggle() end
end)

render()   -- initial state
